mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_sentiments (post_id, sentiment, confidence, analyzed_at, created_at) VALUES (#{postId}, #{sentiment}, #{confidence}, #{analyzedAt}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE post_sentiments SET sentiment = #{sentiment}, confidence = #{confidence}, analyzed_at = NOW() WHERE post_id = #{postId}
mapper.select: SELECT ps.sentiment, COUNT(*) as count FROM post_sentiments ps INNER JOIN posts p ON ps.post_id = p.post_id WHERE p.created_at BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND ps.sentiment != 'UNANALYZED' GROUP BY ps.sentiment

SELECT DATE(p.created_at) as date, SUM(CASE WHEN ps.sentiment = 'POSITIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as positive, SUM(CASE WHEN ps.sentiment = 'NEUTRAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as neutral, SUM(CASE WHEN ps.sentiment = 'NEGATIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as negative FROM posts p LEFT JOIN post_sentiments ps ON p.post_id = ps.post_id WHERE p.created_at BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE(p.created_at) ORDER BY date
